jobs.descriptionHtml:
Physical Therapist | Pediatrics | Hawthorne, CA

Focus on what you got into this profession for: helping your patients thrive.

Prompt Clinical Career Connection is partnering with a Prompt-powered pediatric therapy practice in the Hawthorne, California area that is looking to add a full-time Physical Therapist to its growing team.

This is an opportunity for a PT who loves patient care but is looking for more flexibility, autonomy, professional growth, and a clinical environment that invests in its therapists.

Love being a PT, but not everything that comes with it?

You became a Physical Therapist to make an impact on patients, not to spend your evenings finishing documentation or feel like your entire day revolves around productivity metrics.

This practice is focused on creating an environment where clinicians can build sustainable careers while continuing to grow professionally.

You'll work with a pediatric population from birth through age 21 in a collaborative, multidisciplinary outpatient environment. You'll have the autonomy to manage your caseload while working alongside other rehab professionals who believe in taking a holistic approach to patient care.

And because this is a Prompt-powered practice, you'll have access to technology built specifically to reduce the administrative burden on rehab therapists.

Prompt's AI-powered tools include:

  • Ambient AI Scribe: Helps draft documentation based on the patient encounter, giving you less to write from scratch.

  • Real-Time Compliance: Helps ensure notes meet documentation and compliance requirements before submission.

  • AI Case Summaries: Surfaces relevant patient information and clinical context without digging through the chart.

The impact? 96% of clinicians using Prompt report being able to leave work at work rather than completing documentation after hours.

What you'll do

As a Physical Therapist, you'll provide individualized pediatric care while managing your own caseload and collaborating closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team.

You'll:

  • Provide individualized, one-on-one Physical Therapy sessions based on each child's needs and goals

  • Work with a diverse pediatric population ranging from birth through age 21

  • Independently manage your caseload and deliver consistent, high-quality care

  • Collaborate with other rehab professionals to support a whole-child approach to treatment

  • Partner with the broader team around scheduling, referrals, and coordination of care

  • Build strong relationships with patients and their families

  • Continue developing your clinical skills through mentorship, training, and professional development

Why this opportunity?

This practice is committed to giving clinicians the flexibility, support, and resources they need to build a career they actually enjoy.

You can expect:

  • Flexible scheduling: Monday through Friday, with scheduling flexibility between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM

  • Strong earning potential: Opportunity to earn up to $111,495 annually, including bonus

  • Clinical autonomy: Take ownership of your caseload without sacrificing access to support

  • Unlimited CEUs: Continued investment in your clinical development

  • Mentorship: Ongoing clinical support and opportunities to learn from experienced providers

  • Career growth: Opportunities for specialization and leadership

  • Collaborative care: Work alongside other pediatric therapy professionals

  • No travel: Clinic-based position in the Hawthorne area

  • Prompt-powered technology: Spend less time on administrative work and more time focused on your patients

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Retirement plan

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Unlimited CEUs

  • Paid sick time

  • Paid training

  • Employee discounts

  • Monday through Friday schedule

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Professional development and growth opportunities

What you'll need

We're looking for a Physical Therapist who:

  • Graduated from an accredited Physical Therapy program

  • Holds or is eligible to obtain California PT licensure

  • Is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care

  • Enjoys working with children and their families

  • Is comfortable working independently and taking ownership of their caseload

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Values collaboration with other clinicians

  • Wants to continue learning and growing professionally

Pediatric experience is preferred.

How Career Connection works

Prompt Clinical Career Connection is a free, white-glove career matching service connecting clinicians with Prompt-powered practices that are hiring.

Apply through Prompt and we'll connect with you first to learn more about what you're looking for, answer questions about the opportunity, and determine whether it could be a good match. If there's mutual interest, we'll make the introduction to the practice and support you throughout the process.

No cost. No obligation. Completely confidential.

Whether you're actively looking or simply curious about what else is out there, we'd love to connect.

Apply today and find a clinic where you can spend less time documenting and more time being a PT.

jobs.title: Clinic Director / Physical Therapist | Sunnyvale, CA | Prompt Clinical Career Connection
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Clinic Director / Physical Therapist | Sunnyvale, CA | Prompt Clinical Career Connection

Lead a team. Make an impact. Get back to what you love about physical therapy.

We're partnering with an established outpatient physical therapy practice in Sunnyvale, California, that's looking for a Clinic Director to lead its team!

With more than 20 years of experience serving the surrounding community, this practice is looking for a passionate PT leader who can balance exceptional patient care with team development, operational excellence, and continued growth.

If you're an experienced Physical Therapist who's ready to take the next step in leadership, or an existing Clinic Director looking for a new opportunity, we'd love to connect!

Love being a PT, but ready to make a bigger impact?

At Prompt, we believe the right clinic, supported by the right technology, can make all the difference. That's why we created Prompt Clinical Career Connection, connecting physical therapists with Prompt-powered practices that prioritize clinician success.

We're excited to highlight a leadership opportunity with an established outpatient orthopedic practice that values high-quality patient care, strong clinical leadership, and building a team where clinicians can thrive.

This is an opportunity to help shape the patient and clinician experience while continuing to do what you love about physical therapy.

What makes this opportunity special?

Competitive Compensation: Earn between $110,000 and $120,000 annually, depending on experience, with potential performance-based incentives.

Leadership & Team Development: Lead a team of physical therapists and support staff, helping clinicians grow professionally while building a collaborative, high-performing environment.

Clinical & Operational Impact: Take ownership of clinic operations, patient outcomes, and the overall patient experience while helping drive continued success.

Established Community Presence: Join a practice with more than 20 years of experience serving patients in the surrounding community.

Professional Growth: Continue developing your leadership and clinical expertise through ongoing education and professional development opportunities.

Patient-Centered Care: Help create an environment where clinicians can deliver exceptional care while maintaining strong relationships with their patients.

What you'll do

  • Oversee daily clinical operations, ensuring high-quality patient care and a positive patient experience.

  • Lead, mentor, and support a team of physical therapists and clinic support staff.

  • Conduct patient evaluations and provide hands-on treatment as needed.

  • Monitor patient outcomes and collaborate with clinicians to continuously improve care.

  • Develop and maintain clinic processes that support operational efficiency, compliance, and quality standards.

  • Manage clinic performance, including budgets, productivity, and operational goals.

  • Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, healthcare providers, and the surrounding community.

  • Partner with organizational leadership to review clinic performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support community outreach and initiatives that strengthen the practice's presence.

  • Stay current on advancements in physical therapy and encourage continued clinical development across the team.

The Prompt Advantage: Less documentation, more patient care

Prompt-powered practices have access to AI built specifically for rehab therapy to help reduce administrative work, including:

  • Ambient AI Scribe: Drafts your documentation based on the patient encounter, giving you less to write from scratch.

  • Real-Time Compliance: Helps ensure notes meet documentation and compliance requirements before submission.

  • AI Case Summaries: Surfaces relevant patient information and clinical context without digging through the chart.

The impact? 96% of clinicians using Prompt leave work at work instead of documenting after hours, and therapists at Prompt-powered practices leave the profession at a significantly lower rate than the industry overall.

For a Clinic Director, having access to technology designed to reduce administrative burden can mean more time to focus on patient care, supporting your team, and leading a successful practice.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for Physical Therapists who:

  • Hold a Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree or equivalent qualification.

  • Have an active California Physical Therapist license or are eligible for licensure.

  • Bring clinical experience as a Physical Therapist, ideally in an outpatient orthopedic setting.

  • Have strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Are passionate about mentoring clinicians and building a positive team environment.

  • Understand the importance of operational efficiency, patient outcomes, and regulatory compliance.

  • Are comfortable using electronic medical records and clinic management technology.

  • Want to make a meaningful impact on both patient care and the overall success of a practice.

Previous supervisory or clinic management experience is highly preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $110,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience.

  • Schedule: Full-time, onsite in Sunnyvale, CA.

  • Potential performance-based incentives and bonus opportunities.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

  • Retirement benefits.

  • Paid time off and paid holidays.

  • Continuing education and professional development opportunities.

  • Supportive, team-focused work environment.

Benefits and incentive opportunities are subject to applicable eligibility requirements and program terms.

How Career Connection works

  1. Tell us what you're looking for. We'll learn more about your leadership experience, career goals, and what matters most in your next opportunity.

  2. We'll explore the opportunity together. We'll help you understand whether this Sunnyvale practice aligns with what you're looking for.

  3. We'll make the introduction. If there's mutual interest, we'll connect you directly with the practice.

  4. You decide where to take it from there. No pressure, no obligation.

No cost. No obligation. Completely confidential.

Ready to take the next step in your PT career?

If you're an experienced Physical Therapist who loves patient care but is also passionate about developing teams, improving clinic operations, and making a bigger impact, we'd love to connect!

Apply today to learn more about this Clinic Director opportunity in Sunnyvale, California, and explore what's next for your career.

Please note: This opportunity is with an independently operated physical therapy practice in the Prompt network, not a direct employment position with Prompt Health. Prompt Clinical Career Connection is a complimentary service designed to connect clinicians with practices that align with their career goals.

jobs.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer

Company Overview

Prompt Health is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern B2B enterprise software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. We have established ourselves as the go-to platform in the space, are setting a new standard in healthcare technology, and rapidly growing our market share.

We're constantly identifying new challenges across outpatient therapy and the broader healthcare space. As a Senior Database Reliability Engineer at Prompt, you'll own the health, performance, and cost-efficiency of the databases that power our EMR (electronic medical record) and every product and team built on top of it. This is a role for someone who doesn't just respond to alerts, but gets to the root of problems, prevents them from recurring, and shapes the architecture so the platform scales cleanly as we grow. If you're a database expert who thinks in query plans, replication topologies, and dollars-per-workload, we want you on our team!

Why work for Prompt?

  • Big Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

  • Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

  • Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank. At Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

  • Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the reliability, performance, and availability of all production databases (Aurora MySQL on AWS) across our EHR, Data, and AI teams.

  • Manage database alerting end to end – build and maintain the observability pipeline that feeds database metrics and alerts into Datadog, and fold after-hours database alerts into the DevOps on-call rotation.

  • Educate and train the various engineering teams about proper database hygiene and best-performing queries

  • Implement automated safeguards, including automatic termination of long-running and runaway queries, and fast, always-available visibility into what's currently executing on any instance.

  • Author and maintain database runbooks so that first responders can act on incidents quickly and consistently.

  • Dive deep into problematic queries – diagnose, optimize, and re-index – and drive down both latency and the load that forces us to scale out.

  • Review new EMR and application queries before release, acting as the performance gate that keeps inefficient queries out of production.

  • Architect and continuously right-size our Aurora reader topology and read-routing strategy, matching capacity to real workload and eliminating over-provisioning.

  • Own database cost efficiency: instance right-sizing, reserved-capacity/Savings Plan strategy, and storage tiering.

  • Manage replication health, backups, restore testing, failover, and disaster recovery.

  • Establish safe schema-change and migration practices across teams.

  • Partner with the Platform Architect to determine the best path forward for new and existing database workloads

  • Handle protected health information (PHI) responsibly within a HIPAA-compliant environment.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in database reliability engineering, database administration, or database engineering, including ownership of production systems at scale.

  • Deep MySQL expertise — query optimization, execution-plan analysis, indexing strategy, and replication. Aurora MySQL experience strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience operating large, multi-reader Aurora or RDS clusters at terabyte scale, including read-routing and connection management.

  • Strong command of database observability tooling (Datadog, Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM), Performance Insights, Prometheus/Grafana).

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, and comfort with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

  • Solid AWS operational depth around RDS/Aurora, including cost optimization (instance sizing, reserved capacity, storage types).

  • Experience with on-call/incident response and authoring runbooks.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience standing up or operating a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) and moving analytical workloads off OLTP databases.

  • Experience in a HIPAA-regulated or other compliance-heavy environment handling sensitive data.

  • Familiarity with query auto-remediation tooling (pt-kill / Percona Toolkit, statement timeouts, custom killers).

  • Application-side familiarity (PHP) to collaborate effectively on query review.

  • Knowledge of security best practices for database and cloud environments.

  • Previous experience with agile methodologies and working in fast-paced environments.

Perks – What you can expect

  • Competitive salaries

  • Remote/hybrid environment

  • Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Company-wide sponsored lunches

  • Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

  • Company paid family and medical leave

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

  • Discounted pet insurance

  • FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

  • 401k

  • Credits for online fitness classes/gym memberships

  • Recovery suite at HQ — includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

Here at Prompt, we are committed to fostering a fair and respectful work environment. As part of this commitment, it is our policy not to hire individuals from Prompt Customers unless they have obtained their current employer's explicit consent. We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our People Department.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Experience with EMR Systems

  • Possess strong written and verbal skills

Job Title: Senior Director, Information Security

About Prompt

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, their teams, and the patients they serve. As one of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare SaaS and the new standard in healthcare technology, we are committed to building a team that thrives in our fast-paced, innovative environment.

As Prompt continues to scale, maintaining the trust of our customers, partners, and the patients they serve is critical. We are seeking a Senior Director, Information Security to serve as our HIPAA Security Officer and lead and mature our information security program as we continue to grow.

About the Role

The Senior Director, Information Security serves as the company’s designated HIPAA Security Officer and is accountable for leading and maturing the company’s information security program.

This role owns the governance, control environment, certification and audit programs, security risk management, policy framework, and cross-functional operating model required to maintain compliance with HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory, contractual, and certification requirements.

The Senior Director will work closely with technical and business leaders to translate security requirements and risks into effective controls, clear ownership, and sustainable processes. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to build and mature the program while leveraging strong technical resources across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the company’s designated HIPAA Security Officer, leading the company’s information security program and partnering with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and other stakeholders on related requirements.

  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to independently assess cloud architectures, application architectures, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, identity and access models, software supply-chain controls, and security monitoring approaches, while technical teams retain responsibility for detailed implementation and operations.

  • Own HIPAA Security Rule compliance, including the Security Risk Analysis, security risk-management plan, and ongoing oversight of required safeguards.

  • Own the company’s SOC 2 Type II program and other security certifications, attestations, and assurance programs, including control governance, audit readiness, evidence sufficiency, auditor relationships, identified deficiencies, remediation, and successful completion of audits and assessments.

  • Own the company’s information-security policy and control framework, including policy development, review, exceptions, ongoing governance, and alignment with applicable regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

  • Establish clear ownership for security controls across the organization and ensure deficiencies, vulnerabilities, risks, and remediation plans are identified, prioritized, tracked, validated, and appropriately escalated.

  • Partner with Engineering, DevOps, architecture, and IT leaders to evaluate security approaches and ensure technical controls appropriately address identified requirements, while technical teams retain responsibility for detailed design and implementation.

  • Establish and oversee the company’s vulnerability-management and application-security programs, including expectations for vulnerability identification, penetration testing, secure software development practices, security testing, remediation, exceptions, and escalation.

  • Own the security incident-response framework and coordinate the company’s response to security incidents, partnering with technical teams on investigation and remediation and with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and executive leadership on broader incident assessment and response.

  • Lead the security aspects of third-party risk management, enterprise customer diligence, audits, RFPs/RFIs, and security escalations.

  • Partner with Product, AI, Engineering, Legal, and other stakeholders to establish appropriate governance for emerging technologies and the use of sensitive data.

  • Establish and oversee secure SDLC and software supply-chain requirements, including source-control protections, CI/CD security, dependency and container security, infrastructure-as-code security, secrets management, security testing, artifact integrity, release controls, vulnerability remediation, and risk-based security gates.

  • Maintain appropriate visibility into the effectiveness of the company’s security controls and partner with responsible technical owners to evaluate areas including access controls, data protection, cloud and application security, logging, monitoring, and business continuity.

  • Oversee the effectiveness of the company’s security controls and provide executive leadership with appropriate visibility into significant risks, remediation progress, and emerging security concerns.

  • Continuously improve the company’s information-security operating model so that requirements are clear, ownership is durable, and controls operate effectively in practice.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in information security, risk management, compliance, or related disciplines, including meaningful leadership responsibility.

  • Deep practical knowledge of HIPAA/HITECH and healthcare security and compliance requirements, ideally within a covered entity or business associate environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of cloud security, application security, IAM, vulnerability management, endpoint security, secure SDLC practices, and modern SaaS architecture.

  • Demonstrated experience leading SOC 2 Type II or comparable certification and assurance programs.

  • Experience building or materially improving information security governance, control environments, policy frameworks, audit readiness, and cross-functional accountability.

  • Strong working knowledge of AI security, governance, and risk management, including risks associated with sensitive data and emerging AI technologies.

  • Ability to engage credibly with technical leaders, evaluate proposed approaches, identify material risk, and translate technical issues into business, compliance, and customer impact.

  • Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Legal, Engineering, Product, IT, AI, People, Finance, auditors, customers, and executive leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability across functions without relying solely on direct reporting relationships.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CHC, or similar are preferred but not required where equivalent experience is demonstrated.

Why Work for Prompt?

  • Big Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

  • Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

  • Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank. At Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

  • Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital.

Perks – What you can expect

  • Competitive salaries

  • Remote/hybrid environment

  • Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Company-wide sponsored lunches

  • Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

  • Company paid family and medical leave

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

  • Discounted pet insurance

  • FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

  • 401k

  • Credits for online fitness classes/gym memberships

  • Recovery suite at HQ — includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

As part of this commitment, it is our policy not to hire individuals from Prompt Customers unless they have obtained their current employer's explicit consent. We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our People Department.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Staff Software Engineer

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern B2B enterprise software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. We have established ourselves as the go-to platform in the space, are setting a new standard in healthcare technology, and rapidly growing our market share. We are identifying new challenges across outpatient therapy and the healthcare space at large every day, and we’re looking to bring on a Staff Software Engineer to join our powerful and talented engineering team as we tackle these new opportunities.

As a Staff Software Engineer at Prompt, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving architecture, technical strategy, and execution across major product areas. You’ll tackle some of our most complex engineering challenges, lead the technical direction of high-impact initiatives, and raise the engineering bar through mentorship, design leadership, and direct contribution to the product.

This is an individual contributor role for an engineer who wants to have an outsized technical impact while remaining deeply involved in building and shipping software.

Why work for Prompt?

  • Big Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

  • Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

  • Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank. At Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

  • Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive technical strategy and architecture across major product areas

  • Lead technical design for complex features and initiatives

  • Drive technical refinement and de-risk complex initiatives

  • Mentor engineers at all levels, raising technical standards across the engineering team

  • Lead implementation of particularly challenging and high-impact product features

  • Participate and contribute to the Code Review process, establishing and reinforcing high standards for code quality and maintainability as well as coaching other engineers to do the same

  • Engage in and lead Design Reviews, Product Retrospectives, and other team based ceremonies

  • Conduct technical interviews and evolve hiring standards for future Prompt engineers

  • Drive alignment for key technical decisions across engineers and other stakeholders

  • Identify and proactively address architectural risks, tech debt, process problems, and scalability concerns before they become blockers in collaboration with other Staff Engineers and Architects

  • Identify and advocate for new technologies and patterns as appropriate for the project and team

  • Exercise strong human judgment while utilizing artificial intelligence as a force multiplier for development

  • Spearhead, architect, and organize green-field development for new products when appropriate

Qualifications

  • Meaningful experience as a senior software engineer with a focus on Full Stack web development

  • Experience serving as a technical leader for complex, high-impact engineering initiatives

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor experienced engineers and raise engineering standards across a team

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to comfortably articulate your thoughts and decisions

  • Desire to contribute to the growth of the product, team, and direction of Prompt Therapy Solutions Inc.

  • Experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale applications where data architecture and query performance were a primary concern

  • A working knowledge of the technologies listed below

Technology

  • Advanced working knowledge of PHP, Laravel, Vue.JS, and MySQL or any equivalent (Ruby, Node.JS, React, Angular, Ember, Postgres, MSSQL, etc.)

  • Please only apply if you are interested in a heavy code contribution role. This is a Staff-level individual contributor position, not an Engineering Manager role.

Perks - What you can expect:

  • Competitive salaries

  • Remote/hybrid environment

  • Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Company-wide sponsored lunches

  • Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

  • Company paid family and medical leave

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

  • Discounted pet insurance

  • FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

  • 401k

  • Complimentary subscription to digital fitness classes and wellness content

  • Recovery suite at HQ – includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

FAQ’s

You might want to know…

  • Do I have to come to an office to do a job that is accomplished on a computer?
    No. This is a 100% remote position. Wear sweatpants, put your feet up, listen to music, whatever you fancy is.

  • Will I be working with a manager who has minimal insight into the complexities of engineering?
    No. Come join our team of highly skilled and proven engineers.

  • Is this an Engineering Manager role?
    No. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Staff Engineers at Prompt lead through technical expertise, architecture, mentorship, and execution while continuing to make meaningful contributions to the codebase.

  • Do I have to install a time tracker on my computer because you do not trust my work ethic?
    No. Prompt employees work around U.S. business hours in order to promote collaboration and communication. You’d be expected to do the same within reason. We are flexible and prioritize actual output over how long something took.

  • Will I be working on tedious projects that never make it to production?
    No. We don't have time to waste, your work in the first quarter here will be in the product, we 100% guarantee it.

  • Will the hiring process be dragged out?
    No. You will hear back quickly and the interviewing process is efficient and effective.

  • Is Prompt growing quickly?
    Yes. Over the past several years Prompt has rapidly emerged from a successful startup to the new industry standard in the rehab therapy software space providing “EMR 2.0” technology that handles every aspect of running a rehab therapy practice, optimizing and automating each role in the business.

Here at Prompt, we are committed to fostering a fair and respectful work environment. As part of this commitment, it is our policy not to hire individuals from Prompt Customers unless they have obtained their current employer's explicit consent. We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. Please don't hesitate to inquire with our team.

Prompt Therapy Solutions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, color, religion, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Title: Account Executive (Physical Therapy)

Company Overview:
Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. As the fastest-growing company in the space and the new standard in healthcare technology, we’re looking to bring on an experienced Account Executive as we accelerate our current exponential growth to the next level. If you are a driven and results-oriented individual with a passion for healthcare EHR sales, particularly within the physical therapy and outpatient rehab market, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Why work for Prompt?

  • BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

  • Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

  • Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank, we work long hours when it's needed, but at Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

  • Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back everyday, but it does feel good :)

The Role:

In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our healthcare clients, particularly physical therapy and outpatient rehab practices, identifying new sales opportunities, and driving revenue growth for our EHR software products. You will work closely with our sales, marketing, and development teams to deliver exceptional customer service and achieve our sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage relationships with key healthcare accounts, including physical therapy and outpatient rehab clinics and practices, and develop a deep understanding of their EHR and operational needs.

  • Identify new sales opportunities through market research and client interactions.

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue targets and maximize customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborate with the sales, marketing, and development teams to create and deliver compelling EHR product demonstrations and proposals.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities and customer interactions in our CRM system.

  • Provide regular reports and forecasts to the sales management team on sales pipeline and revenue projections.

  • Self-generate pipeline via outbound efforts while also managing inbound leads.

  • Ensure timely delivery of our EHR software products and services to customers.

  • Attend healthcare and outpatient rehab industry events and conferences to stay up-to-date on market trends and the competitive landscape.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B software sales, with a focus on healthcare technology, EHR/EMR, or software solutions serving physical therapy and outpatient rehab organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience selling software to or working directly with physical therapy or outpatient rehab practices is highly preferred.

  • Bonus experience includes: currently or formerly working as a licensed Physical Therapist or Physical Therapist Assistant, or experience working within the operations, billing, revenue cycle, or administrative functions of a physical therapy or outpatient rehab practice.

  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and delivering exceptional customer service in the healthcare industry.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with healthcare clients at all levels.

  • Experience with CRM software, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Job Title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation

About Us

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. We strive to push the boundaries of what people can expect from healthcare software.

The Role

We're looking for a Demand Generation Team Lead to own Prompt's net new demand end to end, from a practice that has never heard of Prompt through to a qualified demo that sales accepts and opens a deal, plus all the nurture that keeps every stage in between moving. The goal is high quality demos, and you'll always know how demand is performing by source and by segment.

We already have strong content, events, paid, and BDR motions. What we don't have is the person who sits above them and makes their work talk to each other through data and follow up. You'll own the funnel stage by stage and work with Marketing Ops on the HubSpot reporting that shows how every source contributes at each one.

Then you'll use it: to pick the highest leverage campaigns and tactics, to work with the BDRs on which accounts to hit, to tell leadership where the next 400 qualified demos are coming from, and to turn what works into repeatable plays.

You'll set the direction and do the hands-on work, coordinating across marketing, our paid media agency, and the BDR team while just as often building the report, writing the nurture email, or launching the test yourself.

You'll lead a team of 2 from day one and grow it as the engine scales. When leadership wants to know how new business demand is tracking, you already have the answer ready.

Responsibilities

Own the Funnel from Cold to Demo Arrived to Deal Created

  • Own every stage of net new demand, from a practice that has never heard of Prompt down to the demo that's held and accepted by sales. Know what's in each bucket, why it's there, and what moves it forward.

  • Bring the cold cohort, the practices who aren't in any bucket yet, into the funnel with a wide range of campaigns and activities.

  • Own the nurture for every bucket, not just the ones close to booking, and keep the BDR buckets warm so their outreach lands. Give the BDRs the context, message, offer, and timing that turn a lead into a demo that's held.

  • Dissect demo quality by source, channel, and segment and feed it back to the teams creating the demand, so we can tell a channel that produces volume from a channel that produces buyers.

  • Build different plays for different buyers. SMB and mid-market practices move on a different cycle than strategic enterprise accounts, and the targeting, offers, messaging, and follow-up should reflect that.

  • Find where records stall between stages and fix the cause, whether it's the offer, the routing, the timing, or the message.

Demand Gen Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the net new demand strategy and the quarterly plan behind it, and communicate both clearly to company leadership.

  • Lead the 2 people who report into this role, develop them, and grow the team as the engine scales.

  • Direct the day to day work of the demand engine across Marketing Operations, BDR, Content, Events, and our agency, keeping everyone pointed at the same demo and pipeline goals.

Total Clarity & Reporting

  • Be the single source of truth for how net new demand is performing, so anyone in leadership can get a clear, current answer backed by data at any point. You share that picture before anyone has to ask for it.

  • Own the reporting layer in HubSpot with Marketing Ops, including the dashboards, lifecycle stages, properties, and campaign reporting that show how every source contributes at every stage. This is the core of the job, not a tool you happen to know.

  • Pull the data together from where it currently lives apart, including HubSpot, the paid platforms, the website, our BI reporting, and event lists. Use AI to get signal out of messy, disconnected data and to automate between tools that don't talk to each other.

  • Forecast the demo number across every source that feeds it, including paid, events, partnerships, webinars, and LLM-driven search, and line it up with BDR outbound so sales and marketing plan against one shared target.

  • Know your CAC, cost per demo, arrival rate, and demo to opportunity conversion inside and out, and use them to make decisions every week.

New Channel & Campaign Experimentation

  • Keep a steady pipeline of new ideas coming, whether that's a new ad platform, a partnership, a fresh offer, a comparison play, or a campaign we've never run before. Test them, read the results quickly, and put real budget behind the ones that work.

  • Get Prompt in front of buyers researching through LLM-driven search. Leads arriving that way are already deep in evaluation.

  • Reach the parts of our addressable market we haven't touched yet.

Demo Arrival Rate & Speed to Lead

  • Own everything that happens after a demo is booked, from the confirmation and reminder sequences through scheduling, calendar handoffs, and rebooking. A demo that's booked but never attended doesn't count as a win.

  • Work with the BDR and sales teams on speed to lead and follow-up, and with Marketing Operations on the routing, alerts, and automation behind them.

Website & Conversion Rate Optimization

  • Treat the website as a product you own, and run conversion rate optimization across the site, including its landing pages, forms, chat, and the demo booking flow.

  • Test headlines, offers, layouts, and form length on an ongoing basis, and partner closely with design and development so tests ship quickly.

Lead Nurturing & Reactivation

  • Guide your team in designing and running reactivation programs in HubSpot for leads who aren't ready to buy yet, such as stale opportunities, closed-lost accounts, cool-off contacts, webinar attendees, and content leads.

  • Bring them back into a demo conversation, and keep testing your copy, offers, and cadences as you go.

Paid Media and Strategic Growth Partnership

  • Build an exceptionally close working relationship with our paid media partner and a trusted advisor on Prompt's broader marketing strategy. Treat him as an extension of the team and a force multiplier, not simply as an agency executing campaigns.

  • Create a true 1+1=3 partnership. Bring the closest possible view of what is happening inside the business - demo performance, BDR feedback, sales conversations, customer and competitive signals, vertical-level results, and company priorities - so his recommendations become even sharper and more actionable.

  • Work together to sort through the long list of possible opportunities, decide what matters most now, and determine where Prompt should test, stop, or double down.

  • Translate Prompt's priorities in each market and vertical into effective paid programs. Ensure the right segments are receiving the right messages, offers, creative, and landing experiences, and that campaigns reinforce how Prompt intends to win each market.

Minimum Requirements

  • You have at least 7 years in demand generation or performance marketing at a B2B SaaS company, and you've personally owned a demo, meeting, or pipeline number.

  • You've managed and developed a team directly, including hiring, coaching, setting priorities, and holding people to results. You're looking to lead and grow a team rather than only run your own campaigns.

  • You're deep in HubSpot. You've built the dashboards, lifecycle stages, properties, workflows, lead scoring, and campaign reporting yourself rather than asking someone else to.

  • You have strong funnel fluency. You can diagnose performance by source, segment, and stage, pull and validate the data yourself, and turn what you find into action. You can walk us through a time you found something in the data that changed what your team did next.

  • You're still hands-on in the tools. You can point to recent emails you've written, landing pages and forms you've tested, workflows you've set up, and tests you've launched yourself. If your last 2 roles were spent purely directing other people's work, this probably isn't the right fit.

  • You've run paid media yourself across Google Ads and paid social, owned the budget for it, and led the work through an outside agency. You understand the platforms well enough to challenge an agency's recommendations rather than take them at face value.

  • You use AI tools in your daily work, and you can show us what you've built, automated, or figured out faster because of them.

  • You're curious and relentless. You dig into why a number moved, follow it until every loose end is tied off, and ship tests every week rather than every quarter.

Preferred (nice-to-have) qualifications

  • You've marketed to healthcare providers, clinics, or other SMB and mid-market buyers with long consideration cycles.

  • You've built reporting across tools that don't natively connect, such as CRM, BI, and paid platforms.

  • You've partnered closely with BDR teams on speed to lead and follow-up.

  • You've worked with website behavior tracking tools such as Hotjar, Decibel, or similar.

  • You have enough HTML and CSS to review how emails and landing pages are built.

  • You're familiar with ABM platforms such as Demandbase, 6sense, or RollWorks.

Perks - What you can expect

  • Competitive salaries

  • Remote/hybrid environment

  • Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Company-wide sponsored lunches

  • Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

  • Company paid family and medical leave

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

  • Discounted pet insurance

  • FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

  • 401k

  • Credits for online and in-person fitness classes/gym memberships

  • Recovery suite at HQ, includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

Why work for Prompt?

BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank, we work long hours when it's needed, but at Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back everyday, but it does feel good :)

jobs.title: EDI Analyst I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: EDI Analyst I

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. As the fastest growing company in the physical therapy EMR space and the new standard in healthcare technology, we’re looking to bring on an EDI Analyst I to help contribute to the continued growth of our EDI/ERA Department.

This role is an unprecedented opportunity to have an immense impact in our industry leading EDI/ERA Department that ranks 40 Net Promoter Score points higher than our competition (in other words, people love Prompt). We’re looking for someone scrappy, willing to bring new ideas, take on big challenges, and is into doubling down on what works.

We’re doing something special here and this role will be critical in taking Prompt to the next level.

Why work for Prompt?

  • BIG CHALLENGES: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

  • TALENTED PEOPLE: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for physical, occupational, and speech therapists.

  • HEALTHY APPROACH: This isn't an investment bank, we work long hours when it's needed, but at Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

  • POSITIVE IMPACT: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back everyday, but it does feel good :)

The Role:

Our expectation of this role is that you become a major contributor in assisting our clients, often directly engaging with business owners, via our chat/email support channel for all things 837/835 related. This role demands the ability to work independently, leveraging creative solutions to meet our clients' unique needs

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our RCM/Clearinghouse capabilities to effectively respond to incoming customer inquiries across our single-channel support system

  • Work independently with rehab therapy business owners and billing teams leveraging creative solutions to meet our clients' unique needs

  • Resolve common support ticket inquiries in a timely manner. (Clearinghouse rejections, EDI Rules, ERA/EDI Application Help, etc)

  • Improve and advocate for customer experience by identifying opportunities to enhance our enrollment process and provided EDI/ERA support

  • Understand customer needs on a case by case basis to ensure a successful transition (NPI/TIN billing combinations, payer mix, unique billing rules)

  • Ensure ERA/EDI Enrollment Process is underway according to onboarding schedule

  • Provide customers with relevant enrollment paperwork and provide support if requested

  • Monitor accounts for rejections or issues specific to enrollment related items throughout the client's implementation

Minimum Requirements:

  • Working knowledge of X12 message formats (837P, 837I, 835, 276, 277)

  • Detailed understanding of segments and looping/grouping structures

  • Experience performing Healthcare EDI/ERA enrollment process from start to finish for Part A and/or Part B facilities

  • Experience as EDI Analyst, troubleshooting clearinghouse/payer related rejections

  • Clear and effective communicator with excellent verbal and written skills, capable of explaining complex EDI/ERA processes in an understandable manner during calls with business owners

  • Demonstrated extreme attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Ability to meet deadlines with a strong sense of urgency

  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills

  • Self-motivated with the ability to multitask and work independently as well as in a team setting

  • Proven ability to work autonomously, taking initiative to identify and solve problems before they impact our clients. This includes devising innovative strategies to improve our EDI/ERA processes and customer satisfaction.

Preferred (Nice-to-have) Qualifications:

  • Prior startup and/or B2B SaaS technology organization experience

  • Experience in any function of clinical development or medical billing operations (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, system management, information management, medical monitoring, RCM follow up, claim review and submission, etc.)

  • Experience with Zendesk or similar customer support software

  • Experience with healthcare data/systems, ideally clinical/operational clinical trial data/systems

  • Knowledge of e-clinical systems and technologies (e.g. EMR, RTM, HEP, CRM, HIEs, etc)

Perks - What you can expect:

  • Perks - What you can expect:

    • Competitive salaries

    • Remote/hybrid environment

    • Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

    • Flexible PTO

    • Company-wide sponsored lunches

    • Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

    • Company paid family and medical leave

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

    • Discounted pet insurance

    • FSA/DCA and commuter benefits

    • 401k

    • Complimentary subscription to digital fitness classes and wellness content

    • Recovery suite at HQ – includes a cold plunge, sauna, and shower

Here at Prompt, we are committed to fostering a fair and respectful work environment. As part of this commitment, it is our policy not to hire individuals from Prompt Customers unless they have obtained their current employer's explicit consent. We believe in upholding strong professional relationships and respecting the agreements and commitments our customers have with their employees. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this policy. Please don't hesitate to inquire with our team.

Prompt Therapy Solutions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, color, religion, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, or any other protected characteristic. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Prompt Therapy Solutions, Inc is an E-Verify Employer.
